REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a natural, beat-synced approximately 130 BPM party-lookbook groove (musical beat accent every 0.46 seconds, measured upper-body span 44.0px): fluid weight transfers, expressive wrist and forearm paths, and clean posture continuity. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.85:
Begin in the exact basic outfit from the reference room image.
She stands poised in the center of the room, places her fingertips lightly at her waist/top hem at 0.20s, and transfers her weight smoothly with a 15-degree hip-and-shoulder sway (0.20s) with a warm lookbook smile.

0.85–1.45:
She spreads her forearms outward horizontally from her waist at 1.37s to display the full cut and silhouette, and transfers her weight smoothly with a 15-degree hip-and-shoulder sway (1.37s) with natural fabric follow-through.

1.45–2.10:
Leading into 2.10s, she makes a small downward knee pulse and sweeps both forearms wide outward horizontally to the sides on the musical beat.

AT 2.10:
At the widest 2.10s peak of the outward two-arm opening, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.10–3.50:
Complete the wide outward arm opening in Look 1 and takes one confident step forward at 3.00s as the garment settles.

3.50–3.75:
She touches her waist and handbag strap lightly at 3.67s, transfers her weight smoothly with a 15-degree hip-and-shoulder sway (3.67s), and maintains an understated, photogenic smile.

3.75–4.10:
Leading into 4.10s, she makes a small downward knee pulse and sweeps both forearms wide outward horizontally to the sides on the musical beat.

AT 4.10:
At the widest 4.10s peak of the outward two-arm opening, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.10–7.45:
Complete the wide outward arm opening in Look 2 and takes one confident step forward at 7.30s as the garment settles.

7.45–8.00:
She brings both forearms from the sides to rest lightly on her hips with elbows softly relaxed, facing the camera squarely with a bright smile.
End in this exact pose to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a natural, beat-synced approximately 136 BPM travel-lookbook groove (musical beat accent every 0.44 seconds, measured upper-body span 38.0px): fluid weight transfers, expressive wrist and forearm paths, and clean posture continuity. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.85:
Begin in the exact basic outfit from the reference room image.
She looks directly into the camera with a confident smile, makes a playful forward finger-point gesture toward the lens at 0.10s, and bounces lightly on soft knees to the beat (0.10s).

0.85–1.45:
She spreads her forearms outward horizontally from her waist at 1.30s to display the full cut and silhouette, and takes a light rhythmic step forward toward the lens (1.30s) with natural fabric follow-through.

1.45–2.10:
On the pre-beat leading into 2.10s, she shifts her weight onto her supporting leg and thrusts her hand straight forward toward the camera lens in a crisp transformation reach.

AT 2.10:
At the exact 2.10s peak of the forward hand reach toward the camera lens, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.10–3.00:
Continue the forward arm trajectory seamlessly in Look 1, opening her palm briefly toward the lens before retracting her hand in a smooth arc and gives a light rhythmic knee bounce at 2.40s as the hem and accessories respond naturally.

3.00–3.25:
She spreads her forearms outward horizontally from her waist at 3.17s to display the full cut and silhouette, and bounces lightly on soft knees to the beat (3.17s) with natural fabric follow-through.

3.25–3.60:
On the pre-beat leading into 3.60s, she shifts her weight onto her supporting leg and thrusts her hand straight forward toward the camera lens in a crisp transformation reach.

AT 3.60:
At the exact 3.60s peak of the forward hand reach toward the camera lens, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

3.60–7.45:
Continue the forward arm trajectory seamlessly in Look 2, opening her palm briefly toward the lens before retracting her hand in a smooth arc and takes one confident step forward at 4.00s as the garment settles.

7.45–8.00:
She brings both forearms from the sides to rest lightly on her hips with elbows softly relaxed, facing the camera squarely with a bright smile.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a natural, beat-synced approximately 143 BPM party-lookbook groove (musical beat accent every 0.42 seconds, measured upper-body span 50.0px): fluid weight transfers, expressive wrist and forearm paths, and clean posture continuity. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.85:
Begin in the exact basic outfit from the reference room image.
She stands poised in the center of the room, places her fingertips lightly at her waist/top hem at 0.10s, and takes a light rhythmic step forward toward the lens (0.10s) with a warm lookbook smile.

0.85–1.45:
She spreads her forearms outward horizontally from her waist at 1.20s to display the full cut and silhouette, and transfers her weight smoothly with a 15-degree hip-and-shoulder sway (1.20s) with natural fabric follow-through.

1.45–2.10:
Leading into 2.10s, she reaches her hands to grip/touch her waist and top hem, pulling downward crisply on the pre-beat and snapping her wrist forward.

AT 2.10:
At the exact 2.10s wrist-and-hem snap accent, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.10–3.55:
Complete the waist-level hand follow-through cleanly in Look 1 and gives a light rhythmic knee bounce at 2.30s as the hem and accessories respond naturally.

3.55–6.50:
She executes a smooth, full 360-degree turn in place peaking at 4.20s to showcase both the front and rear fit of the outfit, keeping her feet cleanly planted and returning her gaze to the camera lens with a radiant smile.

6.50–7.00:
On the pre-beat leading into 7.00s, she shifts her weight onto her supporting leg and thrusts her hand straight forward toward the camera lens in a crisp transformation reach.

AT 7.00:
At the exact 7.00s peak of the forward hand reach toward the camera lens, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

7.00–7.45:
Continue the forward arm trajectory seamlessly in Look 2, opening her palm briefly toward the lens before retracting her hand in a smooth arc while swaying her hips smoothly at 7.20s as the fabric and accessories follow with natural delay.

7.45–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and angled slightly.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.
